legal.title: Terms, privacy and community rules
legal.draft: Draft for review by the school before launch.
legal.termsBody: Soussy Study is a free study tool. Use it to learn, not to hand in work that isn't yours. The AI plans, explains, quizzes and gives feedback; it will not write graded work for you.
legal.privacyBody: We collect only what a feature needs: your name, date of birth, school, subjects and the files you add. We never sell data, never show ads, and never make your profile public by default. You can download or delete everything from Settings.
legal.rulesBody: Be kind. No private messages between strangers. Camera focus runs on your own device and nothing is recorded. Live study rooms are school-only at first and need guardian approval if you are under 18.

camera.title: Camera focus mode
camera.consentText: Your camera helps you notice when you drift off task. The video never leaves your device, nothing is recorded, and nobody else sees it.
camera.learnMoreText: Everything runs in your browser with on-device models (MediaPipe). Every 2–3 seconds one frame is checked for a face, where you're looking, tiredness and a phone, then thrown away. It never punishes you and never reports to parents or teachers. Turn it off any time.

camera.wrongDone: Got it. I'll be less sensitive.

camera.unsupported: This browser can't run camera focus mode.
camera.cloudText: Send one small, low-quality photo every 2 minutes to Google Gemini for a second opinion.
camera.cloudWarning: These photos leave your device and go to Google's free AI service, which may use them to improve Google's products. Only turn this on if you're comfortable with that. Off by default.
camera.cloudAgree: I understand. Turn on cloud checks
camera.under18: You're under 18. Ask a parent or guardian before turning on cloud checks.
camera.phoneSpotted: 📱 Phone spotted. Put it away; if it stays out for about 20 seconds I'll check in with you.

motivation.2: You're closer than you think. Finish this task and you'll feel amazing.
motivation.3: Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now. Back to it!
motivation.4: Your future self is cheering for you right now. Don't let them down.
motivation.5: Small steps every day add up to big results. One more step now.
motivation.6: The hardest part was starting, and you already did that. Keep the streak alive!
motivation.7: Champions train when nobody is watching. This is your training.
motivation.8: Focus for a few more minutes, then you've earned a real break.
motivation.9: You didn't come this far to only come this far. Let's finish strong!
motivation.10: Distractions will still be there later. Your exam won't wait. Back to work!
motivation.11: Great students aren't born, they're built one focused session at a time.
motivation.12: Stay with it. Future you, holding a 7, says thank you.

rooms.title: Study rooms
rooms.text: Study "together" on camera to stay locked in. Cameras only: no microphones, no chat, no links.

no_age.title: Add your birthday first
no_age.text: Rooms are grouped by age (13–15, 16–17, 18+), so we need your date of birth.

too_young.title: Rooms are for 13 and up
too_young.text: You can still use the timer, camera focus mode and Squads with friends.

needs_guardian.title: A parent or guardian needs to agree
needs_guardian.text: Because rooms use cameras, students under 18 need a parent or guardian to say yes first. Make a link and send it to them; it takes them one tap.

banned.title: You can't join rooms right now
banned.text: A moderator paused your room access after a report. It ends automatically; contact your school if you think it's a mistake.

unavailable.title: Rooms aren't set up yet
unavailable.text: Run migration 0007 in Supabase to turn on study rooms.

rooms.guardianNote: The link only lets your guardian approve rooms; it doesn't open your account.
rooms.rulesText: Live cameras between students need strict rules. Tick each one to agree.

rules.substances: No smoking, vaping, drugs or alcohol.
rules.gestures: No rude gestures, signs or offensive symbols.
rules.nudity: No nudity or sexual content of any kind.
rules.personal: I won't show personal information (address, phone number, ID cards).
rules.camera: My camera stays on me or my desk.
rules.record: I'll never record or screenshot others.

rooms.consequences: Breaking a rule: 1st time a 24-hour ban, 2nd time 7 days, 3rd time permanent. Sexual content involving a minor is a permanent ban at once and is reported to the authorities.
rooms.viewsNote: Others see a small picture that updates every 10 seconds. It's checked on your device before it's sent, and never stored.
rooms.noSchool: Add your school to see school rooms
rooms.friendsTitle: Create or join a study room
rooms.friendsText: Create a room to get a code, then share the code with friends. Or type a friend's code to join. Live video, cameras only (no sound), up to 6 people.
rooms.openText: Rooms between schools open after the KiS pilot, once school rooms have run safely for a month.
rooms.alone: You're the first here. Others will appear as they join.
rooms.privacy: Microphone never used. Pictures are checked on your device, spot-checked by an AI moderator about once a minute, and not stored. Rooms close after 3 hours.
rooms.removed: Your camera was stopped because something in the picture may break the room rules. A moderator will look at it.
rooms.closed: Rooms close after 3 hours. Take a real break!
rooms.full: That room is full (9 people). Try another.
rooms.cameraError: Couldn't start the camera. Check your browser's camera permission.

honesty.title: How to use AI honestly
honesty.intro: Soussy Study's AI is a tutor, not a ghostwriter. This matches the IB's academic integrity policy: AI can help you learn, but work you hand in must be your own, and any AI help you use must be acknowledged.

do.d1: Explain a topic, step by step or with a hint first.
do.d2: Quiz you, make flashcards and mock exams.
do.d3: Give feedback on YOUR draft against the criteria (an estimate).
do.d4: Help you plan: questions to research, an outline to think with.
do.d5: Find sources, which you then read and cite yourself.

dont.n1: Writing any part of an IA, EE, TOK essay or exhibition, or graded homework for you.
dont.n2: Copying AI text into work you submit.
dont.n3: Using AI in a test or exam unless your teacher allows it.
dont.n4: Presenting AI ideas as your own without saying so.

honesty.citeText: If you used AI help in a way your teacher allows, say so. A reference like this works for most schools:
honesty.citeIb: For IB work, cite AI in-text and in your bibliography like any source, and keep notes of what you asked. Check your school's academic integrity policy and ask your teacher or coordinator if unsure.
honesty.estimatesText: Any mark, band or grade the AI gives is an estimate to help you improve. Your teacher's judgement is what counts.
